Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ravindra Pandey, learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the applicant had enticed away the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years.
In the statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that as she was to be married elsewhere, she had gone out of her own free will.

3. Learned A.G.A. as well as the counsel for the complainant opposed the bail prayer.

sentences.text: 4. Considering the fact that the applicant is ready and willing to marry the victim as is also prima facie evident from the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C and the tentative age of the victim has been assessed as 17 years, the applicant who is in custody since 31.05.2024 and has no criminal history is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. Considering the fact that the applicant is ready and willing to marry the victim as is also prima facie evident from the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C and the tentative age of the victim has been assessed as 17 years, the applicant who is in custody since 31.05.2024 and has no criminal history is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
5. Let the applicant Shivam Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 72 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5J(2)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Gomti Nagr Vistar,
District Lucknow, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicnat shall file an affidavit before the trial Court to solemnize the marriage subject to the consent of the victim with all expedition;
(b) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(c) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (d) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Arun  Shivam Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
